newsitem.title: UK: Abbey National dips on Cazenove downgrade.
newsitem.headline: Abbey National dips on Cazenove downgrade.

text.p: Shares in Abbey National Plc fell on Thursday after broker Cazenove cut this year's profit forecast by 2.5 percent and next year's by five percent, dealers said.
The share's technical support from building society flotations will see the price easing also according to Cazenove, dealers said.
Other banking stocks fell in sympathy and with profit-taking continuing following the recent strong advance.
Barclays Plc shares fell 11-1/2p to 1,215-1/2p, Lloyds Bank Plc eased 3-1/2p to 638-1/2p and National Westminster Bank Plc 4-1/2p to 781-1/2p.
